name: Bottom-up Octree Construction
aliases: Octree Volume Construction via Variance Consolidation
definition: A bottom-up algorithm to construct an adaptive-resolution octree from a 3D scalar array, consolidating homogeneous voxels to compress data and building a min/max tree for acceleration.
summary: Bottom-up Octree Construction compresses 3D scalar arrays into adaptive octrees by merging voxels from the finest grid upward, integrating compression with min/max acceleration data.
